value.rationale: Three-objective triangular Pareto fronts are a canonical nontrivial setting in both 2017/2021 hypervolume and 2026 magnitude research. The theorem is a complete natural cardinality-two classification under the indicator introduced in 2026, not a numerical slice or an alternative algebraic form of the old valuation formula: exact transitions L=2,16/5 govern support-stratum topology, unique coordinates and optimal scores. These sharp all-scale benchmarks can detect errors and guide comparisons in multi-point computational indicator design without requiring unproved algorithmic consequences.
